reason: the sre lens's findings the code must fix

findings.text: sre lens, medium: When _ccgl_race_note_post_v returns rc 1 (POST definitively failed), and then _ccgl_remove_label also fails, the zbuild:claimed label stays on the issue; no event names the stuck label — the pipeline.claim.skipped event that the engine eventually emits says only "coordinator failed", not that the label is still there and will block the next run. (plugins/claim-coordinator/github-labels/plugin.sh: "_ccgl_remove_label "$issue" "$_CCGL_LABEL" || true"; happens when: A transient GitHub API outage hits both the note POST and the label-removal call in the same claim attempt; the first real API failure is expected, but the label that was successfully added moments before now has no cleanup path and no specific visibility.; fix: code; ACCEPTED IF: when _ccgl_remove_label fails in the backend_error cleanup paths, an event or a stderr line says the label may still be on the issue and the next run may be blocked — not only that the coordinator failed.); the same kind of problem also at: plugins/claim-coordinator/github-labels/plugin.sh | _ccgl_remove_label "$issue" "$_CCGL_LABEL" || true

sre lens, low: The DSRACE-7 re-read of the issue after posting the holder record swallows its own failure with || true and no event or stderr line; if the re-read fails, arbitration continues with stale label state and no record of why. (plugins/claim-coordinator/github-labels/plugin.sh: "_ccgl_read_labels "$issue" || true"; happens when: A momentary GitHub API error on the issue-view call that follows the note POST; the run proceeds to arbitration without any log entry that the re-read was skipped.; fix: code; ACCEPTED IF: a failure of _ccgl_read_labels in the DSRACE-7 re-read path produces at least a stderr line saying the re-read failed and arbitration is proceeding without fresh state.)

sre lens, low: When the losing run's PATCH of its concurrent-claim note to "not started" fails, the failure is consumed by || true with no event or stderr line; an operator watching the issue sees the note body remain as "concurrent claim by `<holder>`" with no indication that the update was attempted and failed. (plugins/claim-coordinator/github-labels/plugin.sh: "_ccgl_race_note_update "$note_id" "$_CCGL_SLUG" "$issue" "$winner" || true"; happens when: A transient PATCH failure after the race is settled; the loser has already been refused, so the failure is non-blocking, but the note stays in a misleading state and nothing says why.; fix: code; ACCEPTED IF: a failure of _ccgl_race_note_update produces at least a stderr line naming the note id and winner so an operator can tell whether the "not started" update was lost.)
